svg.title: Вращение бедра сидя 90/90 — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Seated 90/90 hip switches, front three-quarter view to show both shoes and knees. LEFT both bent knees angled to image left, one leg externally rotated in front and other internally rotated to side, knees close to floor. RIGHT mirror leg directions with both bent knees angled to image right, same upright seated torso, no chair. Keep clear four limb segments in both poses. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
